cases.name: pointer event re-arms an idle scripted drawable's advance loop
cases.note: The literal typed WAKE_SCRIPT is compiled and initialized as a real Lua ScriptInstance, attached to a production Artboard ScriptedDrawable occurrence with the exact advances-plus-pointer-down method mask, advanced once and parked through ArtboardInstance, dispatched at (1,1) with pointer id 0 and timestamp 0 through the production StateMachine pointer path, and observed through the Lua module's own getter functions. The pointer counter reaches 1 and the re-armed production advance counter reaches 2.

cases.name: keyboard event re-arms an idle scripted drawable's advance loop
cases.note: The literal typed WAKE_SCRIPT is compiled and initialized as a real Lua ScriptInstance, attached to a production Artboard ScriptedDrawable occurrence with the exact advances-plus-keyboard method mask, advanced once and parked through ArtboardInstance, dispatched with Key::a/none/pressed/not-repeat as 65/0/true/false through the production focused StateMachine keyboard path, and observed through the Lua module's own getter functions. The key counter reaches 1 and the re-armed production advance counter reaches 2.
